**Saint-Aubin clinic handover**

**Established:** 4,200 patients; 6 rooms; Mon–Fri 08:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–13:00. 12 nurses (3 shifts), 4 admin. Accreditation April 2022–April 2027; renewal needs infection-control audit. 180 consultations/day; peak 310 (Jan 2025 flu). No-shows 9%, down from 14% after Sept 2024 reminder texts.

**Fixed:** Mar 2024 fridge failure (€2,100 stock lost) — networked alarm, morning checks, paper backup (alarm failed silently once). Nov 2024 allergy field overwritten — records now lock while open.

**Rules:** No renewal without consultation within 12 months (38 breaches found). Vaccine stock counted twice weekly. Excursions >8°C reported same day to regional agency.

**Open:** Second ultrasound postponed June 2025 pending utilisation study — not done; saturation unknown. Nursing coordinator vacant since Aug 2025; two senior nurses rotating; unsustainable beyond winter.
